title: Fortress Gates
description: You stand just inside the fortress gates. The ways on, north and east, are barred by a thin wall of violet light, and three ward stones, left, middle and right, swell and fade with it. Guardians made of shadow drift between the stones, watching you. On the arch behind you, under the black, an older carving shows through: a sun rising over three linked rings. Just inside the threshold Mira keeps the way out, her back to the gatepost.

title: Outer Courtyard
description: This was a garden once. The fountains still stand under a sky that never quite rains, but what runs down them is black and slow, and the statues have all turned their faces away. Grey figures walk the paths in circles, chains of shadow at their ankles, never looking up. By the dry fountain a soldier in a soot-black royal tabard stands rigid, staring at nothing.

title: Mirror Labyrinth
description: Corridors of mirror run away from you in every direction, and in each of them a different Elior looks back. You stand at the mouth of the maze, facing north.

title: Hall of Echoes
description: A long hall, so high the ceiling is lost. Everything that was ever said here is still being said, very quietly: orders, jokes, names, someone counting. Tattered banners hang high along the walls, grimed past reading. At the far end, before the stair, a knight in tarnished armour stands without moving, the way a man stands at a grave.

title: Tower of Shadows
description: A stair winds up inside the black stone, narrow and dark. The walls are cold, and there are no windows. The shadows on the stair move a moment after you do. With every step, something quiet at your ear tells you why you should not have come.

title: Chamber of Whispers
description: A round room at the top of the tower, and the only beautiful room in the fortress. That is what is wrong with it. Crystals grow from the walls, each humming something kind and untrue, and the floor gives a little under your feet, like ice that might hold. At the chamber's heart the Sorceress of Lies waits, her staff crowned with a small silver mask. Your breath catches: it is the mask from Elena's wrist.

title: Memory Vault
description: Glass orbs hang in the air at every height, each one cracked, each one holding a scene that breaks apart before it settles. Among them stands a shadow in the shape of a man. In the east wall is a round door of pale stone.

title: Parents' Vault
description: A small, quiet room. Nothing here is threatening. Memories hang in the air like lanterns, warm and still, and every one of them has your parents in it. It is the saddest and warmest room in the fortress.

title: Throne Chamber
description: A vast chamber under a broken dome. A throne of black stone, twisted like a root, stands at its head. Above a ritual circle King Alden hangs in a prison of crystal, and from his crown a thin thread of light bleeds into a rift in the air: the wound in time. Malakar stands beside it, grey and failing. The wound is killing him too.

title: Willowbrook Field
description: The field behind your home: rows of withered crops under a pale sky, the earth cracked and grey. Grandmother waits at the gate. Mira stands beside her, and Sir Cedric leans on the fence. In the hedge a small light flickers: Nyx, keeping close. The air is quiet.

title: Malakar
description: A tall man in a grey robe that was once a Warden's blue. His hair is white, though he cannot be much older than your father would have been. He leans on the throne as if it is the only thing holding him up. He is looking at the wound, not at you.

title: King Alden
description: The king of Eldoria, grey and thin, as if each week in here had been a year. His crown is dark.

title: Grandmother
description: Your grandmother, flour on her apron and her sleeves pushed up. She has raised you since your parents went away, and she keeps her hands busy when she would rather not answer.

title: Mira
description: Mira, the village healer. Her hut smells of drying sage, and she looks at you a moment longer than people usually do.

title: Sir Cedric
description: A tall knight in old, dented mail. A pale patch on his surcoat shows where his device has been unpicked, and the scabbard at his hip hangs empty. He stands as if he were still on watch.

title: Nyx
description: A woman no taller than you, barefoot, with leaves caught in her hair. The moss is greener where she has stood.

title: Whispers
description: Voices without mouths, thick on the stair, saying the same thing again and again.

title: Shadow
description: It is the shape of a man, thin as smoke. It reaches for the orbs, and they slip through its fingers.

title: Sorceress of Lies
description: She is beautiful in the way the chamber is beautiful: a little too perfect, a little wrong. Her smile never reaches her eyes.

title: Captain of the Guard
description: A captain of the royal guard, his tabard black with soot. His eyes are open but see nothing, and his hand rests on a sword he has forgotten how to draw.

title: Knight of Despair
description: A knight in tarnished armour, a shredded grey cloak hanging from his shoulders. He stands with his back to the door you came in by. His visor is down, and he does not move. When he speaks, his voice is hollow.

title: Ghostly Warriors
description: Pale shapes of soldiers drift among the banners, fighting a battle that ended long ago. Their blades pass through one another without a sound.

title: True Self
description: Your own reflection, in the plain mirror at the labyrinth's heart. It does not copy you. It waits, watching, as if it already knows what you will say.

title: Trapped Servants
description: Grey figures walk the courtyard paths in circles, chains of shadow at their ankles. They wear what is left of kitchen aprons and stable coats. None of them looks up.
